gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Whimsical but stubborn, Flavors stamps out towering lowercase in lines as uniform as bent rod. Noto Sans Kharoshthi has the open, approachable curves, and its dark, thick stripe of text carries the sentence onward.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Flavors draws every stroke at a single constant width, with a lowercase that towers like a stubby carpenter's pencil mark. Noto Sans Khmer matches it with notch-wide openings.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Commanding and a little playful, Flavors piles up diagonals as hefty as its stems. Noto Sans Khojki offers wide exits that let light through, and big, clear eyes on every e.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals and lowercase close in height. Its rounds stay unlatched and open, so a long page moves along softly under Flavors, which never varies its line width.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-kr: Noto Sans KR comes with stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height. Noto Sans KR also keeps its curves generously gapped, a quality that makes Flavors' bent-tubing letters feel even bolder above it.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Flavors builds horizontals and verticals of identical thickness, like rod stock, then lifts its whimsical, towering lowercase above them. Noto Sans Lao Looped settles into solid word blocks.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Gaping curves, tall bodies, big attitude. Flavors is best at commanding attention with a single uniform weight, while Noto Sans Limbu is best at gliding through a paragraph without any fuss.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Noto Sans Lisu has tiny gaps between its ascender tops and x-height line, and wide-open s curves. Flavors adds hairline-free, whimsical weight over it.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Noto Sans Lydian keeps its capitals barely taller than its lowercase, with openings as wide as a sprung paper clip. And Flavors, built like bent tubing of one gauge, gives the top of the page a loud whimsical swagger.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Tall lowercase and a funnel-wide throat in every e make Noto Sans Mahajani read modern and clear. And Flavors, drawn in a single line weight, gives it a commanding, whimsical counterpart.
